name: Shahrokh Shah
role: Afsharid shah of Iran (In Western Khorasan)
contribution: The Afsharid king of the western part of Khorasan from 1748 to 1796, with a two-month interruption.

checks.lead: Shahrokh Mirza (Persian: شاهرخ‌میرزا‎; 1734–1796), better known by his dynastic title of Shahrokh Shah (شاهرخ‌ شاه‎), was the Afsharid king (shah) of the western part of Khorasan (corresponding to the present-day Khorasan Province) from 1748 to 1796, with a two-month interruption.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
